UAE Golden Visa Guide for Tech Founders, IT Experts & Business Owners (Eligibility)

A comprehensive eligibility masterclass on securing the 10-year UAE Golden Visa for tech entrepreneurs, software engineers, AI specialists, and business owners.

ADVAQ UAE Advisory Team
9 Min Read · Published July 2026
UAE Federal Authority (ICP) Golden Visa Rules
Golden Visa Pathways
  • •10-Year Self-Sponsored Residency: No employer sponsor needed. 100% independent residency status.
  • •Entrepreneur Pathway: Own a technical startup valued at AED 2,000,000+ or backed by an accredited incubator (DIFC, Hub71).
  • •Specialized Talent Pathway: IT executives and software leads earning AED 30,000+/month with a bachelor's degree.
  • •No 6-Month Travel Restriction: Stay outside the UAE for extended periods without losing visa validity.

1. What Is the UAE 10-Year Golden Visa?

The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residency program introduced by the UAE government to attract world-class tech founders, investors, scientists, and highly skilled professionals.

It grants 10 years of self-sponsored residency, complete business flexibility, and immunity from standard employment sponsorship rules.

2. Eligibility for Tech Founders & Startup Owners (AED 2M Rules)

Entrepreneurs qualify for a 10-year Golden Visa under two main criteria:

  • Owning a UAE company with a total capital valuation of at least AED 2,000,000 (~$545,000 USD).
  • Obtaining an official recommendation letter from an accredited UAE tech incubator (e.g. Hub71 Abu Dhabi, DIFC Innovation Hub).

3. Eligibility for Software Engineers & IT Executives (AED 30k Salary)

Highly skilled IT professionals and software architects qualify under the Specialized Talent / High-Salaried Professional category if they satisfy:

IT Talent Requirements Checklist:

  • Valid employment contract in the UAE as Chief Technology Officer, Lead Architect, or Senior Developer.
  • Minimum basic monthly salary of AED 30,000 (~$8,170 USD).
  • Attested Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant technical field.

4. Step-by-Step Nomination & ICP Application Process

  1. Submit initial nomination request to Ministry of Economy or Dubai Culture / ICP portal.
  2. Receive official Golden Visa approval letter.
  3. Cancel existing 2-year visa and undergo VIP medical fitness test.
  4. Receive 10-year Golden Emirates ID.

5. Exclusive Perks: Family Sponsorship & Unlimited Travel

Golden Visa holders can sponsor their spouse, unmarried sons up to age 25, daughters of any age, and domestic staff for full 10-year residency permits.
